scenarios.name: ADCS_and_sat_replay_reproducibility
scenarios.boundary: ADCS current evidence is retrospective/used-cohort reproducibility; PHM/sat replay is retrospective and truth/activation aware. New independent ADCS trajectory groups are still required for a fresh generalization claim.

scenarios.name: single_parameter_detection_and_possible_cause
scenarios.boundary: Numeric anomaly detection is generic. Cause candidates require a registered/explicit parameter semantic mapping and remain provisional when knowledge is E0.

scenarios.name: single_parameter_detection_classification_and_cause
scenarios.boundary: No universal single-signal classifier is claimed. Classification is available only for empirically qualified/admitted profiles; non-identifiable or unsupported signals must abstain.

scenarios.name: multi_parameter_detection_localization_classification_and_possible_cause
scenarios.boundary: The frozen 33-channel ADCS P2 profile can execute detection, affected-component localization and fault classification through strict admission. Localization is not root-cause proof and formal diagnostic voting remains separately governed. Partial/mismatched profiles degrade safely.

scenarios.name: document_parse_answer_library_memory_and_graph_proposal
scenarios.boundary: Native text/document governance, RAG, reviewed proposals and non-voting knowledge workflows are implemented. Real MinerU/Anything2Ontology domain-quality qualification remains an external-provider requirement; active KG updates remain governed.

scenarios.name: data_plus_literature_joint_diagnosis_context
scenarios.boundary: MODEL, KG, LITERATURE and CORE branches are traceable in a joint evidence package. Retrieved/reviewed literature remains non-voting for committed core diagnosis unless a future independently qualified governed promotion authorizes otherwise.

scenarios.name: expert_correction_controlled_self_evolution
scenarios.boundary: Expert correction can produce evidence-bound failure cases and six-layer improvement candidates, sealed challengers, exact evaluation receipts, governed review packets and rollback-covered promotion preflight. Production promotion remains a human/governance gate; online self-rewriting is not enabled.

scenarios.name: continuous_open_set_and_active_diagnosis
scenarios.boundary: Case timeline and next-best-observation suggestions are supported, with abstention/unknown boundaries from model decision policy. Suggested observations never authorize spacecraft control actions.

external_dependencies.does_not_block: current used-cohort replay and exact-profile runtime contract

external_dependencies.blocks: production claim for arbitrary complex PDF/ontology extraction quality
external_dependencies.does_not_block: native text processing, adapter contracts, review-only knowledge proposals

external_dependencies.blocks: universal classification/localization for arbitrary parameter names
external_dependencies.does_not_block: generic detection or exact admitted domain profiles

external_dependencies.blocks: turning document claim shadow/non-voting context into a formal fusion vote
external_dependencies.does_not_block: non-voting joint evidence, reviewed stance display and expert evidence references

stability_contract.allowed_delta: Exclude historical records and initialize mutable governance ledgers empty; preserve runtime, models, data, knowledge assets, current admission contracts and scenario boundaries.
stability_contract.claim_boundary: Current source delivery packaging does not create new diagnostic, provider, flight, causal or safety qualification.

software_functionality_delta: NONE; packaging/governance/documentation pruning only, plus current-delivery-aware governance health checks.
